name: University of Newcastle Indigenous Accommodation Scholarship
summary: Commonwealth-funded scholarship for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students relocating from remote, rural or regional areas to study at UON.
key: A total benefit of up to $5500, paid in two equal instalments of $2750.
who: Enrolled or enrolling in an enabling, undergraduate or postgraduate program at UON
Of Australian Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander descent
Relocating from a remote, rural or regional area to study
how: Apply through the online portal (PDF uploads only)

source.label: University of Newcastle: Indigenous Accommodation Scholarship

evidence.quote: Offers a total benefit of up to $5500, paid in two equal instalments of $2750 following the Semester 1 and 2 census dates.
Be relocating from a remote, rural, or regional area to study with UON.
